chunks: Then We appointed you leaders in the land after them to see how you behaved.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be khalifah (successors) in the land according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yunus (10:14) is often interpreted as highlighting the dual nature of human stewardship, where authority is granted not as an absolute right but as a trust (amanah) subject to divine scrutiny. The term 'khalifah' here underscores the responsibility of the Israelites to uphold justice and faith, serving as a precursor to the broader Shia concept of leadership being contingent upon moral and spiritual integrity. This testing mechanism reinforces the idea that earthly power is transient and evaluated based on adherence to divine will.
